title: FIR direct-form convolution
description: O(n*k) direct-form nested multiply-accumulate convolution. NOT overlap-add. 256-tap windowed-sinc lowpass against 8192 Float32 noise samples. Both variants use identical f32 MAC loops.

inputs.generation: xorshift32 noise 8192 Float32 + 256-tap Hann-windowed sinc lowpass fc=0.25 sample-rate

oracle.policy: N+K-1 f32 output samples. Max relative error ≤ 1e-3 on non-zero samples. NaN/Inf fails.
oracle.floatingPointPolicy: JS uses f64 intermediates; Wasm uses native f32. Accumulated MAC divergence within tolerance.
oracle.deadCodeDefense: Complete output array hashed and compared sample-by-sample.

work.tolerance: Items, bytes, MACs, loads, stores must match exactly.
